title: Sol de Janeiro’s CEO on building the brand’s next chapter: from male grooming to travel retail
summary: Sol de Janeiro, the Brazilian Bum Bum Cream maker, has entered its next phase of growth under new CEO Jordan Saxemard. This is how he is tapping into new audiences and building on co-founder Heela Yang’s lasting legacy

extraction.key_fact: 솔 데 자네이로가 새로운 최고경영자 체제에서 남성 그루밍 및 트래블 리테일 등으로 확장하며 다음 성장 단계에 진입했다.
